title: Seacliff Center RV Park
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Seacliff Center RV Park is located near Seacliff State Beach by the historic S.S. Palo Alto cement ship that once floated offshore as an entertainment vessel for dining, dancing and fun, now permanently moored at Seacliff California State Beach. Today she remains at Seacliff Beach and serves as an artificial reef and eco system for marine life. Fishing on the pier is allowed without a license.
